messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm opening an RFC to standardize parameter naming in docs and SDK snippets. Goal: fewer mismatches between Python examples, REST, and JS samples.

sachin: 👍 which convention are you proposing?

maria: draft suggestion: docs canonical = snake_case. For JS snippets, show snake_case but add a one-line note with the camelCase JS equivalent. Not changing public API surfaces yet, just docs and example snippets.

elaine: important distinction — are we only changing code blocks in .md files or also screenshots/diagrams?

maria: primarily fenced code blocks in markdown. i'll flag diagrams and screenshots in the checklist for manual updates.

jonah: fine by me as long as we include a migration note for external contributors and a glossary mapping for terms/names.

kevin: i can run a codemod for the code blocks. would like the exact scope list before I start.

maria: initial file targets in the RFC: docs/getting-started/**, docs/reference/sdk/snippets/**, examples/**, tutorials/**. codemod limited to fenced code blocks.

sachin: also include the quickstarts on the website repo; i'll coordinate with webops for a staged deploy after changes.

maria: proposed workflow:
1) RFC PR with naming table + file list (me)
2) codemod branch (kevin)
3) manual fixes + reviews (kevin/sachin)
4) glossary and style guide update + CI checks (maria)

elaine: timeline? can we squeeze this into the next docs release window (two weeks)?

kevin: i can deliver codemod results in ~4 working days once RFC is merged.

maria: draft glossary key plan: use snake_case keys in metadata YAML/JSON — e.g., model_variant — and human-facing label in prose: "Model variant". Add a short definition: "A specific model build or quantization profile used for inference."

jonah: nit: keep glossary labels Title Case, keys snake_case. I'll scan SDK READMEs for references after codemod.

maria: adding a short naming table to the RFC: 
```
Docs canonical form: snake_case (in code and metadata)
JS examples: show snake_case in sample then inline map to camelCase
Codemod scope: fenced code blocks only; exclude prose and JSON fixtures unless explicitly listed
```

kevin: sharing codemod command draft in PR: 
```
python tools/codemods/case_transform.py --scope fenced --from camelToSnake --apply
```

elaine: add a CI check to validate that Python/JS snippet blocks still parse. prevents broken examples slipping in.

maria: good call. i'll add a markdown-snippet lint job to CI that verifies snippet parsing for py/js.

pr-bot: PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/426 (RFC: docs parameter naming + codemod plan) by maria

kevin: saw the RFC. i'll start the codemod branch and push a WIP by Thursday. ping me once RFC is merged so i can rebase.

sachin: i'll leave a comment in the PR about web deploy steps and quickstart redirects.

maria: i'll include a checklist in the PR description (filenames, owners, CI steps, manual diagram pass). please add any files you think I missed.

jonah: small request — include an entry in docs release notes about the change so customers notice example name differences.

maria: will do. if anyone objects to snake_case, raise it by EOD tomorrow. otherwise i'll merge the RFC and kick off the codemod process.

kevin: :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — will post the final checklist and links here after merge.
